The '''Guiding Hand''' was an emerging criminal organization during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. The Guiding Hand's members were fanatically loyal to their leader, the crazy [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Duras Fain]]. Fain was known to hate the illegal [[Spice/Legends|spice]] trade, hence the Guiding Hand's repeated attacks on the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]]' spice shipments. This disturbed the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] who then sent enforcers to resolve the problem. Meanwhile, a [[The Barsen'thor|Jedi Knight]] was in search of Fain to cure him of the illness that was making him act irrationally.

In the end, Fain recovered and the Guiding Hand was reformed as a charity organization.
